title: Annotatio III §.VII: After Lombard and the Scholastics dispute the true Conversion-mode — subtle and sharp
pass_a_gloss: Namely after the true Mode of Conversion in the Eucharist had been disputed by the Scholastics and their prince Peter Lombard, book 4 distinction 11 pp. 311–313, as subtly as sharply.
pass_b_english: That seating follows Scholastic dispute on the true Conversion-mode in the Eucharist.
Lombard (bk. 4 dist. 11 pp. 311–313) leads — subtle and sharp alike.
source_text: Postquam nempe de vero Conversionis in Eucharistia Modo, à Scholasticis & horum principe Petro Lombardo lib. 4. dist. 11. pag. m. 311. 312. 313. subtiliter æquè atque acriter disputatum esset.

rejected: subtly and also acre by acre
